attributes.probed_form: ITEM 3, fndiff --clean pool rows: the queued rule was 'do NOT suppress a pool row whose two symbols differ in KIND (lbl_ vs @NNN)'. Calibrated over all 257 unit pairs: 3,399 such rows in 642 functions, against 45 wrong-datum rows in 22. Shipped instead as a VALUE decision (see the law record) reporting, never scoring. ITEM 4, wf_word_diff: --by-region partitions at --ops cluster boundaries PLUS basic-block leaders (clusters alone put 58 of fn_800D8BCC's 66 words in one 141-instruction equal run, true and useless, because a recolor lives entirely inside equal runs); the RELOC-SYMBOL MISMATCH column pairs relocations by function-relative OFFSET at identical instruction words and marks a row PAIRING UNRELIABLE when mnemonics disagree within 4 instructions. ITEM 1, rc_recolor_class: frame column from the prologue `stwu r1,-N(r1)` in both streams, STACK_LAYOUT prefixed onto the classification. ITEM 2, fndiff --ops: BRANCH-TARGET DIVERGENCE printed above the clusters, discriminated on the branch DISPLACEMENT plus a clear span. ITEM 5, savedregs: an always-printed scope banner plus --per-web. ITEM 6, nearmiss: the `d=` column replaced by probe.py's `real`, with `clean=` printed only on disagreement. ITEM 7, propose-record: a `report_all` collector plus --size composition. ITEM 8, a work_claim gate requiring an other-lane ownership attribution AND a withholding word in one sentence. ITEM 9, discard_refusal reporting OUTSIDE and STRADDLING hunks from the lists they describe. ITEM 10, rule_derive --emit plus --list-classes.
attributes.residual: THREE THINGS DELIBERATELY NOT DONE. (1) Item 3's WRONG-POOL-VALUE class is REPORTED, never scored: making it a diff row would move `real` project-wide, which the project forbids ('naming a pool constant must never change a score'), so 72 flagged functions are printed as a channel beside the score rather than inside it. (2) Item 9's queued symptom was NOT reproduced: three constructed nested-block declaration hoists (including one where identical declaration lines exist in a sibling function, the shape difflib could mis-pair) all attributed every hunk INSIDE the function. What reproduced is a different defect in the same output lines, fixed. Whether the original observation had a third cause is unresolved and needs the CT lane's actual tree to settle. (3) The 72 pool-defect and 15 reloc-symbol functions the new columns surface are RECORDED (see the companion claim) and NOT fixed: every one of them lives in a TU this lane does not own.

hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: Run `python tools/gdl/fndiff.py <unit> <fn> --clean` over the 23 flagged functions that read `real 0` today and read the printed POOL-DEFECT rows. If most are benign granularity artifacts the prefix comparison missed, the class is noise and this hypothesis is wrong; the four checked so far (PlayerRestoreState, start_magic, move_logic00, AtreeNodeInit) were all genuine, each confirmed against the retail DOL bytes through tools/gdl/poolval.py. Zero builds.
hypothesis.screened_against_target: yes — every quoted value was read from the retail image at its symbols.txt address via poolval.py, and every quoted pairing was confirmed in the aligned `fnasm --diff` view rather than at a same-absolute-offset comparison.
hypothesis.statement: ITEM 3 CARRIES A LIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE THE NEXT LANE SHOULD NOT RE-DERIVE. The queued rule ('do not suppress a kind-differing pool row') was refuted from two independent directions in one run: this lane's corpus calibration measured the class at 3,399 rows in 642 functions, and the NM lane closed init_enemy byte-exact while it carried a kind-differing row (@1785 vs lbl_80346938, the s32->f64 magic constant) whose VALUES agree — so the rule as written would have made a new STRICT exact read as not-exact. The shipped decision procedure is the VALUE behind the two symbols, and the motivating adsInitFromHeader case is still served because its values differed. The UNTRIED extension: WRONG-POOL-VALUE currently reports 177 rows in 58 functions and nobody has worked one. Two of the four spot-checked are gameplay defects (player.c::PlayerRestoreState reads 0.5 and 30.0 where the retail reads 100.0 and 500.0; enemy.c::move_logic00 has pi and 2*pi swapped), which suggests the class is a harvest lane, not a tooling curiosity.
